# 雖然 …，但係 … · *seoi1 jin4 …, daan6 hai6 …*

**Meaning:** although …, (but) … · **Level:** B1 · **Topic:** Connecting words

> ⚠️ **Draft — awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [report it](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new?template=content-error.yml&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20grammar%2Fseoi1-jin4-although).

雖然 introduces a contrast and 但係 the main point. Unlike English, both words are normally used in the same sentence.

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **雖然好貴，但係好好食。** |
| Jyutping | seoi1 jin4 hou2 gwai3, daan6 hai6 hou2 hou2 sik6. |
| Yale | sēui yìhn hóu gwai, daahn haih hóu hóu sihk. |
| Bopomofo | ㄙㆤㄧ¹ ㄧㄣ⁴ ㄏㄛㄨ² ㄍㄨㄜㄧ³, ㄉㄚㄣ⁶ ㄏㄜㄧ⁶ ㄏㄛㄨ² ㄏㄛㄨ² ㄙㄧㆶ⁶. |
| English | It's expensive, but it's delicious. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **雖然佢好忙，但係佢都嚟咗。** |
| Jyutping | seoi1 jin4 keoi5 hou2 mong4, daan6 hai6 keoi5 dou1 lai4 zo2. |
| Yale | sēui yìhn kéuih hóu mòhng, daahn haih kéuih dōu làih jó. |
| Bopomofo | ㄙㆤㄧ¹ ㄧㄣ⁴ ㄎㆤㄧ⁵ ㄏㄛㄨ² ㄇㄛㄥ⁴, ㄉㄚㄣ⁶ ㄏㄜㄧ⁶ ㄎㆤㄧ⁵ ㄉㄛㄨ¹ ㄌㄜㄧ⁴ ㄗㄛ². |
| English | Although she was busy, she still came. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **我雖然學咗兩年，但係仲講得唔好。** |
| Jyutping | ngo5 seoi1 jin4 hok6 zo2 loeng5 nin4, daan6 hai6 zung6 gong2 dak1 m4 hou2. |
| Yale | ngóh sēui yìhn hohk jó léuhng nìhn, daahn haih juhng góng dāk m̀h hóu. |
| Bopomofo | ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄙㆤㄧ¹ ㄧㄣ⁴ ㄏㄛㆶ⁶ ㄗㄛ² ㄌㆦㄥ⁵ ㄋㄧㄣ⁴, ㄉㄚㄣ⁶ ㄏㄜㄧ⁶ ㄗㄨㄥ⁶ ㄍㄛㄥ² ㄉㄜㆶ¹ ㆬ⁴ ㄏㄛㄨ². |
| English | Although I've studied for two years, I still don't speak well. |
